arena.title: The arena
arena.subtitle: Pick your fighters, press Start and watch them battle it out on their own.

pick.title: Fighters
pick.teamsHint: Pick at least 2 fighters for each team. Fighters join teams in the order you pick them.
pick.tournamentHint: Pick 3 to 16 fighters for the bracket.
pick.lockedHint: Picks are locked until this tournament ends.
pick.juggHint: Pick five challengers to face the juggernaut.
pick.storyHint: Pick a stage, then the pair you bring into it.
pick.teamTourHint: Teams of {{size}}: pick enough fighters for 3 to {{max}} full teams. Fighters join teams in the order you pick them.
pick.teamTourLocked: Picks are locked until this team tournament ends.

alive.title: Still standing
alive.empty: The battle has not started yet.

feed.title: Kill feed
feed.emptyBody: Knockouts show up here as they happen.

winner.title: {{name}} wins!
winner.doubleKo: Double K.O. This match will be replayed.
winner.storyComplete: Story complete! The Axiom has been rewritten.
winner.teamDropped: {{name}} team drops to the losers bracket

arena.idle: Press Start to begin the battle

bracket.title: Bracket
bracket.losersHint: Lose once in the winners bracket and you drop down here. Lose again and you are out.
bracket.grandHint: The winners bracket champion meets the losers bracket champion. If the losers bracket fighter wins, a reset match decides the title.

arena.idleTournament: Press Start for the next match

jugg.label: Juggernaut
jugg.perks: Flies on wings, has 10 moves and double health.

hybrids.title: Hybrids
hybrids.empty: No hybrids yet. Fuse two fighters and the hybrid shows up here, ready to pick.

quest.title: Quest fighters
quest.empty: Earn quest fighters on the Quests page. Each one is strong enough to take on a Story boss alone.

bosses.title: Bosses
bosses.empty: Beat a Story boss and it joins your roster here, phases and all.
bosses.unlockJoined: {{name}} has joined your roster. Pick it in any mode except Story.

newgen.title: New generation
newgen.empty: Beat a Story boss for a 2 in 5 chance that a young new-generation fighter joins you. Young, but just as strong.
newgen.unlockJoined: {{name}} has joined your roster. Young, and every bit as dangerous as the veterans. Pick them in any mode except Story.

me.title: Your character
me.empty: You haven't made a character yet. Make one in Free World and it shows up here, ready to pick.

title.tagline: Elemental fighters clash until only one is left standing.

modes.story: Eight chapters with a fused or teamed-up pair.
modes.teamTournament: Teams fight through a bracket together.
modes.free: Hang out in six places and start a fight anywhere.

roster.title: Meet the 16 fighters
roster.subtitle: Every fighter has one power and a set of moves built on it. Pick your favourites in the arena and see who is left standing.

forms.title: Forms
forms.subtitle: Pushed low, every fighter breaks into its form once per fight: new colours, new stats and two new moves. Hybrids and bosses don't transform.
forms.nightmare: Quest fighters: darker, stronger, three new moves. Can't be stunned or frozen.
forms.surge: New generation: twelve original moves of their own. Can't be stunned or frozen.
forms.super: Turbo only: seven emeralds, golden light and twelve new moves.
forms.hyper: Turbo only, after Super Form. Can't be stunned or frozen.

empty.title: No fighters with this style
empty.body: Pick another style to see more fighters.

hybridsEmpty.title: No hybrids yet
hybridsEmpty.body: Fuse two fighters and the hybrid joins the roster here. Hybrids you make in Story mode show up too.

roster.hybridsFiltered: No hybrids with this style yet.

bossLocked.title: Not beaten yet
bossLocked.body: Beat {{name}} at the end of Story chapter {{chapter}} to add it to your roster.

questLocked.title: Not earned yet
questLocked.body: Finish its quest to add {{name}} to your roster.

newGenLocked.title: Not unlocked yet
newGenLocked.body: Every Story boss you beat gives a 2 in 5 chance that a new-generation fighter joins you. {{name}} could be next.

story.title: Story
story.chapterIntro: Bring two fighters into each stage. Fuse them into one hybrid that keeps both move sets, or send them in side by side with team attacks.
story.fuseHint: One fighter with {{count}} moves: both move sets plus two mixed moves (in bold).
story.teamHint: Both fight side by side. Each one gets a team attack that mixes your two powers:
story.sameHint: The same fighter twice can only fuse.
story.chapterLocked: Clear chapter {{n}} to open this one.

ch5.title: Chapter 5: The Heart of the Rift

fusion.title: Fuse a hybrid
fusion.intro: Pick two fighters. The hybrid keeps both move sets and gains two mixed moves. The same fighter twice makes a Prime hybrid of its own.
fusion.moves: {{count}} moves. Mixed moves are in bold.
fusion.savedNote: {{name}} is saved. Pick it under Hybrids in the arena, or find it on the Fighters page.

quests.title: Earn new fighters
quests.subtitle: Every quest earns a quest fighter for good: 12 moves, its own entrance and a Nightmare Mode. Fights in any mode count, and progress is saved in this browser.

card.sealed: This quest opens when its fighter arrives in a later update.

fold.title: A Tear in Space
fold.story: Something keeps watching the arena from the other side of the air. Give it enough fights to study and it will step through.

gameover.title: Game Over
gameover.story: A black figure with one green eye has been glitching into the background. Prove the arena is worth playing and he'll load in.

gamma.title: Critical Mass
gamma.story: Readings off the scale under the arena floor.

speed.title: Faster Than Sound
speed.story: Afterimages in the replays that nobody can explain.

portal.title: Between Worlds
portal.reward: Earns Liminal, Portal and Matter Manipulation
portal.story: A door keeps opening where no door should be.

encore.title: Encore
encore.story: The crowd keeps cheering after the arena goes quiet, and nobody is in the stands.

cranes.title: A Thousand Cranes
cranes.story: Folded paper birds turn up in the corners of the arena, a few more after every fight.

facet.title: Under Pressure
facet.story: Crystals keep growing up through the cracks in the arena floor, a little bigger after every knockout.

dunes.title: Shifting Sands
dunes.story: A dune has started creeping in from the edge of the arena, and something under it is waiting.

free.canvasAria: The Free World: your party walking around, or a fight in progress

house.name: House
house.blurb: Your place. Put your feet up, watch some TV, raid the fridge.

city.name: City
city.blurb: Busy streets full of fighters going about their day.

dojo.name: Dojo
dojo.blurb: Quiet mats, a worn training dummy and a corner to meditate in.

arcade.name: Arcade
arcade.blurb: Neon, cabinets and a claw machine that might actually pay out.

park.name: Park
park.blurb: Grass, a lake with ducks, and a bench in the shade.

rooftop.name: Rooftop
rooftop.blurb: Up above the city at dusk, with the stars coming out.

foodcart.label: Get a bite at the food cart
foodcart.done: {{name}} grabs something from the food cart.

fountain.label: Toss a coin in the fountain
fountain.done: {{name}} tosses a coin and makes a wish.

dummy.label: Train on the dummy
dummy.done: {{name}} lands a combo on the training dummy.

claw.label: Try the claw machine
claw.done: {{name}} wins a prize from the claw machine.

bench.label: Sit on the bench
bench.done: {{name}} takes a breather on the bench.

lake.label: Skip a stone
lake.done: {{name}} skips a stone across the lake.

controls.hint: Walk with the arrow keys or A and D. Press E at a star to do something there.

fight.title: Start a fight here
fight.intro: Your party fights on one side, right where you're standing. Pick up to 6 opponents for the other side. There's no timer: it goes until one side is down.
fight.hint: Your party fights on its own, like everywhere else in the arena.

party.title: Your party
party.intro: Pick who you are, and up to 3 companions who walk with you and fight on your side.
party.empty: Nobody is walking with you yet. Add up to 3 companions.
party.bossNote: Bosses you beat in Story and rehabilitate can join your party too.

bosses.title: Bosses you've beaten
bosses.empty: Beat a chapter boss in Story to meet it here.
bosses.hint: Rehabilitate a beaten boss and it can walk with you and fight on your side.
bosses.done: {{name}} has turned over a new leaf and can join your party.

me.title: Your character
me.empty: Make your own stick-figure fighter. Its powers decide how it looks and fights.

creator.title: Your character
creator.intro: Name your stick figure, give it up to 3 powers and choose its look. The powers decide its colours, stance, entrance, effects and moves.
creator.previewAria: Your character standing in the stance its powers give it
creator.powersHint: The first power is your main one: it sets your colour, stance and voice. A second power adds its glow and a fused entrance.
creator.lookHint: The colours always come from your powers. Pick what you wear, how tall you stand and which of those colours your body takes.
creator.needName: Give your character a name to save it.
creator.savedNote: Saved. {{name}} is walking as you in Free World and can be picked in the arena.

own.title: Your own power
own.hint: Type any power the game doesn't have and the AI turns it into a real one, with its own colours, effects and moves. It becomes your main power.
own.label: Power idea
own.placeholder: e.g. storm piano, magnet bees, shadow ink
own.replaceNote: Making a power takes one of your 3 slots, so your last picked power will be dropped.

error.short: Type a power idea of at least 2 letters.
error.busy: That's a lot of powers in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.refused: That one can't be a power here. Try a different idea.
error.failed: The power couldn't be made right now. Try again.
